answer: AI agents can resist Sybil attacks by requiring proof-of-work tied to computationally expensive, resource-intensive tasks, akin to forging a unique, heavy ferrous artifact with a specialized quill, or maintaining a perpetually lit, energy-demanding lantern. This proof-of-resource mechanism makes it prohibitively costly for an attacker to mint thousands of fake identities, as each would require substantial, verifiable computational effort or expenditure of a scarce resource.
